'''Lktim''' was one of the largest cities on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Sometime after the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] took control of the city.<ref name="Droid Trouble">{{JournalCite|3|Droid Trouble}}</ref>
